lessons.title: Legislators back minister on Para Games absence
lessons.title_zh: 立委力挺部長缺席帕運會

paragraphs.en: Taiwanese lawmakers from different political parties have expressed firm support for Sports Minister Lee Yang. Lee chose to skip the opening celebration and related official activities of the Asian Para Games, which are being held in Japan's Aichi-Nagoya region. His withdrawal came after event organizers unexpectedly reduced his pass status from a government minister to an ordinary guest of Taiwan's National Paralympic Committee.
paragraphs.zh: 來自不同政黨的台灣立法委員對體育部長李洋表示堅定支持。李洋選擇缺席在日本愛知及名古屋地區舉行的亞洲帕拉運動會開幕慶典和相關官方活動。在此之前，賽會主辦單位出乎意料地將他的通行證身分從政府部長降級為台灣中華帕拉林匹克總會的一般貴賓，促使他做出退賽決定。

paragraphs.en: The Ministry of Sports explained that Lee had initially received an official pass that reflected his ministerial position. However, Japanese organizers altered his entry status on Sunday morning without providing any explanation. Describing this sudden change as regrettable, Taiwanese officials lodged a serious complaint with the Asian Paralympic Committee and sought diplomatic assistance to settle the issue.
paragraphs.zh: 體育部解釋，李洋最初收到的是反映其部長職位的官方通行證。然而，日本主辦單位在週日上午未提供任何解釋就更改了他的入場身分。台灣官員將這項突如其來的改變形容為令人遺憾，並向亞洲帕拉林匹克委員會提出嚴重抗議，同時透過外交管道尋求協助以解決此爭端。

paragraphs.en: Lawmakers quickly rallied behind the minister. Chinese Nationalist Party (KMT) legislator Lai Shyh-bao argued that the Ministry of Foreign Affairs must protest to Tokyo, questioning why Japan repeatedly mistreated Taiwanese officials. Meanwhile, Democratic Progressive Party (DPP) lawmaker Chen Pei-yu called on the public to condemn Beijing's political pressure. She warned that local athletes and coaches "could experience the same plight." Executive Yuan Secretary-General Chang Tun-han also stated that citizens should back the sports ministry regardless of their party preferences.
paragraphs.zh: 立法委員迅速團結支持這位部長。中國國民黨（KMT）立委賴士葆主張外交部必須向東京當局提出抗議，質疑日本為何再三不當對待台灣官員。與此同時，民主進步黨（DPP）立委陳培瑜呼籲大眾譴責北京的政治施壓。她警告，本土運動員與教練「可能會遇到相同的困境」。行政院秘書長張惇涵也表示，無論政黨偏好為何，民眾都應該支持體育部。

paragraphs.en: This dispute was not the first obstacle Lee encountered during his trip to Japan. On September 18, his entrance to an Asian Games flag-raising ceremony was delayed for an hour because officials claimed the Olympic Council of Asia (OCA) had barred him. Host organizers later admitted the problem was a misunderstanding caused by poor communication. Although Lee did not attend Sunday's opening parade, 25 Taiwanese athletes and team members proudly joined the march. Taiwan has sent 71 competitors to take part in 12 sports at the games.
paragraphs.zh: 這次爭端並非李洋在訪日期間遇到的首個障礙。在9月18日，他參加亞運會升旗典禮的入場被延誤了一個小時，因為官員聲稱亞洲奧林匹克理事會（OCA）禁止他出席。主辦單位後來承認該問題是溝通不良所造成的誤會。儘管李洋並未參加週日的開幕遊行，但仍有25名台灣運動員和團隊成員驕傲地參加了遊行。台灣今年共派出71名選手參加該賽事的12個運動項目。

lessons.title: M1A2T tanks to join southern Lien Yung drills
lessons.title_zh: M1A2T戰車將參加南部聯勇操演

paragraphs.en: United States-made M1A2T Abrams tanks are scheduled to take part in a major defense drill for the second time next month. According to a military source, the vehicles will join the Lien Yung exercise in southern Taiwan. The army’s 584th Armored Brigade, which operates these American-built vehicles, has already moved them to the Joint Operations Training Base located in Pingtung County.
paragraphs.zh: 美製M1A2T艾布蘭戰車預計於下個月第二度參加重大國防演習。根據軍方消息來源指出，這批車輛將加入在南台灣舉行的聯勇操演。操作這些美造車輛的陸軍裝甲第584旅，已經將它們運往位於屏東縣的三軍聯合作戰訓練基地。

paragraphs.en: The upcoming maneuvers will take place from late next month through December. During this month-long joint exercise, the tank crews will test their combat coordination. The M1A2T Abrams tanks first joined a major domestic exercise during the annual Han Kuang drills in August. While the nationwide Han Kuang exercises feature live-fire drills and represent Taiwan's primary military maneuvers, the Lien Yung event is the nation's second-largest.
paragraphs.zh: 即將展開的演習將於下個月下旬一路進行至十二月。在這場為期一個月的軍事聯合演習期間，戰車組員將測試他們的戰鬥協調能力。M1A2T艾布蘭戰車是在八月舉行的年度漢光演習中，首度加入國內的重大演習。雖然全國性的漢光演習包含實彈演練，且代表著台灣最主要的軍事演習，但聯勇操演則是規模第二大的演訓。

paragraphs.en: Conducted in southern Taiwan, the Lien Yung drills serve as an essential test of how well the three branches of the nation's armed forces—the army, navy, and air force—work together to repel an invading enemy. Conscripts who are completing their mandatory one-year military service will also take part in this year's exercise, according to the source.
paragraphs.zh: 在南台灣舉行的聯勇操演是一項關鍵測試，檢驗國家陸海空三軍共同擊退進犯敵軍的合作表現。該消息來源表示，正在服一年義務役的役男也將參加今年的演習。

paragraphs.en: Currently, these modern tanks are operated exclusively by volunteer soldiers rather than conscripts. Su Tzu-yun, director of the defense strategy and resources division at the Institute for National Defense and Security Research, noted this operational distinction. However, Su emphasized that it is still vital for conscripts to join large-scale live-fire events like Lien Yung so that they can gain more advanced training.
paragraphs.zh: 目前，這些現代化戰車全由志願役士兵操作，而非義務役役男。國防安全研究院國防戰略與資源研究所所長蘇紫雲指出了這項操作上的差異。然而蘇紫雲強調，義務役役男參加像聯勇操演這樣的大規模實彈演習仍然至關重要，如此他們才能獲得更進階的訓練。

paragraphs.en: Under an agreement approved by Washington in 2019, Taiwan procured 108 M1A2T Abrams tanks from the US at an estimated cost of 1.45 billion US dollars. Out of the total shipment, 38 tanks arrived at the 584th Armored Brigade late last October, followed by another 42 in April. The remaining 28 vehicles are undergoing testing as technicians prepare them for active service.
paragraphs.zh: 根據華盛頓當局在2019年批准的一項協議，台灣以約14.5億美元的費用向美國採購了108輛M1A2T艾布蘭戰車。在全數軍備中，有38輛戰車於去年十月下旬運抵裝甲第584旅，隨後另有42輛在四月送達。其餘28輛車輛目前正接受測試，技術人員也正為它們投入服役預作準備。

lessons.title: ‘Once-in-a-lifetime chance’: Japan launches historic mission to collect rocks from Mars’s moon Phobos
lessons.title_zh: 「千載難逢的機會」：日本展開歷史性任務前往火星衛星「火衛一」採集岩石

paragraphs.en: Japan has successfully sent a spacecraft into space to collect rock samples from one of Mars's moons. Propelled by the flagship H3 rocket, the Martian Moons Exploration (MMX) probe lifted off before dawn from the Tanegashima Space Centre. The Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency (JAXA) announced that the spacecraft had separated smoothly from the rocket, which brought great excitement to flight controllers.
paragraphs.zh: 日本已成功將一艘太空船送入太空，以從火星的一顆衛星採集岩石樣本。在旗艦級 H3 火箭的推進下，「火星衛星探測」（MMX）探測器在黎明前從種子島太空中心升空。日本宇宙航空研究開發機構（JAXA）宣布太空船已與火箭順利分離，這為飛行控制人員帶來了極大的興奮。

paragraphs.en: The primary goal of this five-year mission is Phobos, an uneven, potato-shaped moon orbiting Mars. The five-tonne spacecraft is expected to enter Mars's orbit in August next year. When it reaches its destination, the main craft will deploy a small French-German rover called Idefix. Because gravity on Phobos is extremely weak, the rover will bounce for several minutes before stopping. It will spend one hundred days examining the surface to select safe landing locations.
paragraphs.zh: 這項為期五年的任務主要目標是火衛一（Phobos），這是一顆形狀不規則、形似馬鈴薯並環繞火星運行的衛星。這艘五公噸重的太空船預計將於明年八月進入火星軌道。當抵達目的地時，主太空船將釋放一輛名為 Idefix 的法德合作小型探測車。由於火衛一上的重力極為微弱，該探測車在停下之前將會彈跳數分鐘。它將花費一百天的時間勘測表面，以挑選安全的著陸地點。

paragraphs.en: After the initial survey, a four-legged lander will touch down on Phobos to drill and vacuum up at least ten grams of material. This collection process will take only two hours before the lander lifts off again. The spacecraft will also observe Mars's smaller moon, Deimos, before departing Mars's orbit in November 2030, with an expected return to Earth in 2031. German Space Agency rover chief Markus Grebenstein stated, "It is a once-in-a-lifetime chance."
paragraphs.zh: 在初步探勘之後，一架四腳著陸器將降落在火衛一上，以鑽探並吸取至少十公克的物質。這項採集過程在著陸器再次升空前僅需花費兩個小時。該太空船還將在 2030 年 11 月離開火星軌道之前觀察火星較小的衛星火衛二（Deimos），預計將於 2031 年返回地球。德國太空總署探測車主管 Markus Grebenstein 表示：「這是一個千載難逢的機會。」

paragraphs.en: Five international space agencies are working together on this 578-million-dollar project. Scientists hope the gathered rocks will resolve how the two moons formed—whether through a massive collision or by Mars capturing passing asteroids. In addition, the findings may reveal how habitable environments developed on terrestrial planets and assist upcoming human missions to Mars.
paragraphs.zh: 五個國際太空機構正在這個耗資 5.78 億美元的計畫中攜手合作。科學家希望收集到的岩石能解答這兩顆衛星是如何形成的——究竟是透過劇烈的天體撞擊，還是由火星捕獲路過的微行星。此外，這些發現或許能揭示類地行星上如何形成適合居住的環境，並有助於未來的載人火星任務。

paragraphs.en: Both the United States and China are also competing to retrieve Martian material. Although NASA's Perseverance rover has collected samples on Mars, its return journey was halted by the Trump administration. Meanwhile, China aims to launch its Tianwen-3 mission around 2028, meaning its samples could arrive on Earth as early as 2031.
paragraphs.zh: 美國與中國也正在競爭取回火星物質。儘管美國國家航空暨太空總署（NASA）的「毅力號」探測車已在火星採集樣本，但其返回地球的行程被川普政府叫停。與此同時，中國計畫在 2028 年左右發射「天問三號」任務，這意味著其樣本最早可能在 2031 年抵達地球。

lessons.title: Colorado wildlife overpass cut vehicle-animal collisions by 91%, report finds
lessons.title_zh: 報告指出：科羅拉多州野生動物天橋使車輛與動物碰撞事故減少91%

paragraphs.en: In Colorado, wild animals are finding a much safer way to travel across a busy highway. A newly released report reveals that a wildlife overpass has helped reduce collisions between animals and vehicles by 91 percent since it was finished ten months ago. Officials have tracked elk, bears, pronghorn, and even frogs using the bridge, which crosses over an interstate between Denver and Colorado Springs.
paragraphs.zh: 在科羅拉多州，野生動物正找到一條穿越繁忙公路的安全通道。一份最新發布的報告顯示，自從十個月前完工以來，一座野生動物天橋已協助減少了91%的動物與車輛碰撞事故。官員們追蹤到麋鹿、熊、叉角羚甚至青蛙都在使用這座橋樑，它跨越了丹佛與科羅拉多泉之間的一段州際公路。

paragraphs.en: Before this crossing was constructed, the Colorado Department of Transportation recorded an average of one crash involving animals every day in the area. The grass-covered bridge is 200 feet wide and 209 feet long, spanning six traffic lanes. It connects 39,000 acres of habitat on both sides of the road. In addition to the bridge, the whole system includes miles of eight-foot-tall fences and five large tunnels underneath the highway.
paragraphs.zh: 在這座通道建造之前，科羅拉多州交通部記錄到該地區平均每天發生一起涉及動物的車禍。這座覆蓋著草皮的橋寬200英尺、長209英尺，橫跨六個車道。它連接了公路兩側39,000英畝的棲息地。除了天橋之外，整個系統還包含數英哩長的八英尺高圍欄以及公路下方的五座大型地下通道。

paragraphs.en: Tunnels do not always work well for large game because they can limit movement, especially for bull elk with huge antlers. Chuck Attardo, an environmental manager at the state transportation department, explained that elk and pronghorn prefer open structures that let them look out over long distances. Thanks to the bridge, pronghorn were recorded crossing to the west side for the first time in decades. Furthermore, smaller creatures such as rabbits, coyotes, and the threatened Preble's meadow jumping mouse also benefit from the route.
paragraphs.zh: 地下通道對大型獵物來說並不總是好用，因為它們可能會限制行動，尤其是對長著巨大鹿角的公麋鹿而言。該州交通部的環境經理查克·阿塔多解釋說，麋鹿和叉角羚更喜歡能讓牠們眺望遠方的開闊結構。多虧了這座橋，幾十年來首次記錄到叉角羚穿過公路前往西側。此外，兔子、土狼以及受威脅的普雷布爾草地跳鼠等較小型的生物也從這條路線中受益。

paragraphs.en: Brandon Marette, a wildlife biologist for Colorado Parks and Wildlife, shared that seeing a mother elk safely guide her calf was extremely touching. He stated, "All came to fruition in that one moment." Nearly 20 similar crossings are currently being built across the United States. Although this project was supported by 22 million dollars in federal aid and 8 million dollars from the state, workers finished it for only 15 million dollars. Colorado now hopes to construct more crossings to keep both drivers and wildlife safe.
paragraphs.zh: 科羅拉多州公園與野生動物管理局的野生動物生物學家布蘭登·馬雷特分享說，看到一隻母麋鹿安全地引導牠的小鹿令人非常感動。他表示：「在那一刻，所有的努力都實現了。」目前全美有近20座類似的通道正在興建中。儘管這個計畫獲得了2,200萬美元的聯邦補助和800萬美元的州政府資金，工作人員最終僅花費1,500萬美元就完工了。科羅拉多州現在希望建造更多通道，以確保駕駛人和野生動物的安全。

grammar.explain: 由逗號隔開的 which 引導關係子句，用來補充說明前面的先行詞 the bridge。

lessons.title: Five ways El Niño is affecting the weather around the world
lessons.title_zh: 聖嬰現象影響全球天氣的五種方式

paragraphs.en: El Niño has continued to gain strength, causing droughts, floods, and severe heatwaves across the globe. According to the World Meteorological Agency, this record-breaking event will persist until at least 2027. In Indonesia, the unusually hot and dry conditions have triggered the country's worst wildfire season since 2015. Since January, fires have burned over 895,657 hectares of land, forcing schools to close and exposing millions of residents to toxic haze that causes respiratory illness.
paragraphs.zh: 聖嬰現象持續增強，在世界各地引發乾旱、洪水與嚴重的熱浪。根據世界氣象組織（World Meteorological Agency）的說法，這場創紀錄的現象將至少持續到 2027 年。在印尼，異常炎熱且乾燥的氣候引發了該國自 2015 年以來最嚴重的野火季。自一月以來，大火已燒毀超過 895,657 公頃的土地，迫使學校停課，並使數百萬居民暴露於引發呼吸道疾病的毒霧霾中。

paragraphs.en: Meanwhile, warmer waters have fueled an exceptionally active hurricane season in the eastern Pacific. The region has already recorded 22 named storms and 12 hurricanes, well above normal numbers. Warm ocean temperatures and weaker high-altitude winds allowed storms like Hurricane Polo to intensify rapidly. In addition, the basin saw three hurricanes churning at the same time twice in one month, a phenomenon last seen in 2015.
paragraphs.zh: 與此同時，較溫暖的海水助長了東太平洋異常活躍的颶風季。該地區已經記錄到 22 個命名風暴和 12 個颶風，遠高於正常數量。溫暖的海溫與較弱的高空風力，使像波洛（Polo）這樣的颶風得以迅速增強。此外，該流域在一個月內兩度出現三個颶風同時旋轉的情況，這種現象上次出現是在 2015 年。

paragraphs.en: In contrast, the Atlantic Ocean has remained unusually calm due to wind shear that tears storms apart. While an average year brings five hurricanes by this point, only one hurricane, Isaias, has formed so far. This makes Isaias the latest-forming hurricane on record during the satellite era, which began in the 1960s.
paragraphs.zh: 相較之下，大西洋由於能撕裂風暴的風切變而顯得異常平靜。儘管平均而言此時會出現五個颶風，但到目前為止僅形成了一個名為伊賽亞斯（Isaias）的颶風。這使得伊賽亞斯成為自 1960 年代衛星時代開始以來，有記錄中最晚形成的颶風。

paragraphs.en: In India, the critical monsoon rainfall dropped 13% below average, creating severe challenges for farmers. Although the Indian Meteorological Department (IMD) considered this total within the normal range, rainfall varied widely across the country. The eastern and northeastern areas suffered exceptional drought with rainfall 26% below average, while sudden heavy rains interrupted prolonged dry spells.
paragraphs.zh: 在印度，關鍵的季風降雨量比平均低了 13%，為農民帶來嚴峻挑戰。儘管印度氣象局（IMD）認為此總量仍處於正常範圍內，但降雨在全國各地的分布差異極大。東部與東北部地區因降雨量低於平均 26% 而面臨異常乾旱，同時突如其來的暴雨也打斷了漫長的乾旱期。

paragraphs.en: Finally, storms have brought severe floods and landslides to Japan and eastern China. According to the Japanese Meteorological Agency, 10 tropical cyclones have formed in the western Pacific, the most in a season since 1966. Under El Niño conditions, storms form further east, giving them more time over warm waters to gather strength before making landfall.
paragraphs.zh: 最後，風暴為日本及中國東部帶來了嚴重的洪水與土石流。根據日本氣象廳的資料，西太平洋已形成 10 個熱帶氣旋，是 1966 年以來單季最多的一次。在聖嬰現象的影響下，風暴形成的地理位置更偏東，讓它們在登陸前有更多時間在溫暖的海面上積聚能量。

lessons.title: Ex-OpenAI worker accused of planting device had Saudi support, says court filing
lessons.title_zh: 法院文件稱：遭控裝設裝置的前 OpenAI 員工獲得沙烏地阿拉伯支持

paragraphs.en: A former engineer at OpenAI has been accused of secretly installing an audio recorder inside one of the company's meeting rooms. According to court documents filed in California, prosecutors claim that thirty-five-year-old Abdulrahman Alfozan, a Saudi national, received strong support from his home government. The Saudi government did not immediately answer requests for comment.
paragraphs.zh: OpenAI 的一名前工程師被指控在該公司的一間會議室內祕密裝設錄音裝置。根據在加州提交的法院文件，檢察官聲稱三十五歲的沙烏地阿拉伯籍男子阿卜杜勒拉赫曼．阿爾福贊（Abdulrahman Alfozan）獲得了母國政府的大力支持。沙烏地阿拉伯政府並未立即回應置評請求。

paragraphs.en: Alfozan had worked for the artificial intelligence firm for approximately one year before the incident. On September 30, OpenAI discovered a recording device that was plugged into the back of a television and covered with toilet paper. Company security placed a camera in the room, and on October 5, video footage showed Alfozan entering the room and looking behind the screen. The Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) arrested him on October 9, and OpenAI immediately ended his employment contract.
paragraphs.zh: 在這起事件發生前，阿爾福贊已在這家人工智慧公司工作了大約一年。9 月 30 日，OpenAI 發現了一個插在電視機背面並用衛生紙遮蓋的錄音設備。公司維安人員在該房間內安裝了攝影機，而在 10 月 5 日，錄影片段顯示阿爾福贊走進房間並查看螢幕後方。美國聯邦調查局（FBI）於 10 月 9 日將他逮捕，OpenAI 也隨即終止了他的聘僱合約。

paragraphs.en: Prosecutors warned that this alleged behavior could harm United States national security. They pointed out that company executives had held meetings with government officials in that exact room during the period the recorder was active. Legal filings also revealed that Alfozan was in frequent contact with a member of the Saudi royal family.
paragraphs.zh: 檢方警告，這種涉嫌的行為可能會危害美國的國家安全。他們指出，在該錄音設備運作期間，公司高階主管曾在該會議室與政府官員舉行會議。法律文件還透露，阿爾福贊與一名沙烏地王室成員保持著頻繁的聯繫。

paragraphs.en: Authorities considered Alfozan a serious flight risk because he had planned to fly to Riyadh on a one-way trip shortly after his arrest. His wife told investigators that her visa was expiring and that the family intended to move permanently. On October 10, his wife and son left for Doha on business-class tickets funded by a Saudi military official. On Monday, a federal judge denied bail, stating "there is a risk of non-appearance that is significant." If convicted, Alfozan faces up to five years in prison and a fine of 250,000 dollars.
paragraphs.zh: 當局認為阿爾福贊有嚴重的逃亡風險，因為他原定在被捕後不久搭乘單程航班飛往利雅德。他的妻子向調查人員表示，她的簽證即將到期，全家打算永久搬遷回國。10 月 10 日，他的妻子和兒子搭乘由一名沙烏地軍方官員出資購買的商務艙機票前往杜哈。週一，一名聯邦法官拒絕了保釋申請，表示「存在重大的不到庭風險」。如果罪名成立，阿爾福贊將面臨最高五年的監禁以及二十五萬美元的罰款。

lessons.title: Mission set to blast off for Mars to grab a piece of its moon
lessons.title_zh: 任務即將升空前往火星以採集其衛星碎片

paragraphs.en: A major space mission led by the Japanese Space Agency is preparing to launch on Monday. The Mars Moons Exploration (MMX) spacecraft aims to collect a sample from Phobos, one of the two moons of Mars, and bring it back to Earth. If the journey succeeds, scientists will receive the first-ever soil returned from Mars or its moons for direct study in laboratories.
paragraphs.zh: 一項由日本太空總署主導的重大太空任務正準備於週一發射升空。火星衛星探測（MMX）太空船旨在從火星的兩顆衛星之一「火衛一」採集樣本，並將其帶回地球。如果這趟旅程成功，科學家將獲得有史以來第一批從火星或其衛星帶回的土壤，以便在實驗室中直接進行研究。

paragraphs.en: The spacecraft is scheduled to reach Phobos in August 2027. Unlike our large Moon, Phobos and Deimos are tiny, irregular objects that look somewhat like potatoes. Setting down on Phobos is extremely difficult because the tiny moon has very weak gravity, while nearby Mars exerts a powerful gravitational pull. Before landing the main spacecraft, a small rover will explore the surface to find a safe landing site.
paragraphs.zh: 該太空船預計於2027年8月抵達火衛一。與我們巨大的月球不同，火衛一和火衛二都是微小且形狀不規則的天體，看起來有點像馬鈴薯。降落在火衛一上極為困難，因為這顆微小的衛星本身重力非常微弱，而鄰近的火星則施加著強大的重力引力。在主要太空船降落之前，一輛小型探測車將先探索地表，以尋找安全的著陸點。

paragraphs.en: Once the spacecraft touches down, it will use a robotic arm and two tools to collect about 10 grams of dust. Although this amount seems tiny, Dr Chrysa Avdellidou from Leicester University stated that "it's worth every gram" because researchers can examine even individual grains. The material will be sealed in a small capsule, which is expected to return to Earth in 2031 and touch down in South Australia's Woomera desert.
paragraphs.zh: 太空船一旦著陸，將利用機械手臂和兩具取樣器採集約十公克的塵埃。儘管這個數量看似極少，但來自萊斯特大學的克里莎・阿夫德利杜博士表示「每一公克都值得」，因為研究人員連單一微粒都能進行檢視。這些物質將被密封在一個小型密封艙中，預計於2031年返回地球，並降落在南澳的伍默拉沙漠。

paragraphs.en: Scientists hope this rare sample will finally solve the mystery of how the Martian moons formed. The rocks could show whether Phobos was created from debris after a giant impact on Mars or if it was an asteroid captured by the planet's gravity. Prof Sara Russell from the Natural History Museum also noted that dust from Mars might have landed on Phobos over time. Therefore, the mission may also provide pristine fragments of Mars itself, free from the contamination that affects Martian meteorites on Earth.
paragraphs.zh: 科學家希望這個珍貴的樣本能最終解開火星衛星如何形成的謎團。這些岩石可以顯示火衛一究竟是在火星遭受巨大撞擊後的碎片所形成，抑或是被這顆行星的重力所捕獲的小行星。來自自然史博物館的莎拉・羅素教授也指出，隨著時間推移，來自火星的塵埃可能已經落到了火衛一上。因此，這項任務也可能提供火星本身未受污染的純淨碎片，免於地球上影響火星隕石的污染。

vocab.zh: 原始的；純淨未受污染的

grammar.explain: 逗號後的關係代名詞「which」引導非限定關係子句，針對先行詞「a small capsule」進行補充說明。

lessons.title: ‘Crucial opportunity to act’ as study finds most of Europe’s wild bee species in decline
lessons.title_zh: 研究發現歐洲多數野生蜂物種數量正在減少，並指出這是「採取行動的關鍵機會」

paragraphs.en: A new scientific study has revealed that most of Europe's wild bee species and roughly half of its hover fly species have declined over the past hundred years. Historical records dating back to 1921 show that more bee species are decreasing than increasing across all parts of Europe, with the sole exception of the Alpine region. This serious drop in pollinator variety is especially noticeable in the Atlantic and Continental regions.
paragraphs.zh: 一項新的科學研究顯示，歐洲大部分的野生蜂物種以及大約半數的食蚜蠅物種在過去一個世紀中數量有所減少。自 1921 年以來的歷史紀錄顯示，除了阿爾卑斯山地區這唯一的例外之外，歐洲各地減少的蜂類物種都多於增加的物種。這種授粉昆蟲多樣性的嚴重下降，在大西洋和歐洲大陸地區尤為明顯。

paragraphs.en: Pollinators play a vital role in natural environments and human survival. Nearly 90 percent of wild flowering plants and over three-quarters of leading food crop types depend partly on animal pollination. The United Nations Food and Agriculture Organization has warned that falling pollinator populations trigger chain reactions that harm wildlife and weaken ecosystems against climate change and environmental pressure.
paragraphs.zh: 授粉昆蟲在自然環境與人類生存中扮演著至關重要的角色。將近百分之九十的野生開花植物以及超過四分之三的主要糧食作物種類，都部分仰賴動物授粉。聯合國糧食及農業組織已經警告，授粉昆蟲數量的減少會引發連鎖反應，不僅危害野生動植物，還會削弱生態系統抵禦氣候變遷和環境壓力的能力。

paragraphs.en: Carlos Martínez-Núñez, the lead author of the study from the Spanish National Research Council, stated that the findings give humanity "a crucial opportunity to act before further declines occur." While a few tough species are increasing today, researchers caution that these creatures might not survive as global heating and habitat destruction get worse. Furthermore, even though around 91 percent of the recorded species were seen between 2001 and 2020, their likelihood of being found in specific areas has clearly dropped.
paragraphs.zh: 來自西班牙國家研究委員會的該研究主要作者卡洛斯．馬丁內斯－努涅斯（Carlos Martínez-Núñez）表示，這些發現給予人類「在進一步減少發生前採取行動的關鍵機會」。雖然少數適應力強的物種目前正在增加，但研究人員警告，隨著全球暖化和棲地破壞加劇，這些生物可能無法繼續存活。此外，儘管記錄中的物種約有百分之九十一在 2001 年至 2020 年間曾被發現，但牠們在特定地點被發現的機率已明顯下降。

paragraphs.en: These troubling findings coincide with the 17th United Nations conference on biodiversity, known as Cop17, held in Yerevan, Armenia. World diplomats have gathered to assess targets for this decade, such as safeguarding 30 percent of land and sea, reforming 500 billion dollars in harmful subsidies, and restoring damaged ecosystems. Although wildlife is disappearing at an alarming speed, governments have failed to achieve any nature targets established since the 1992 Rio agreement.
paragraphs.zh: 這些令人擔憂的發現正好與在亞美尼亞葉里溫舉行的第十七屆聯合國生物多樣性大會（簡稱 Cop17）同時發生。世界各國外交官齊聚一堂，評估本十年的目標進展，例如保護百分之三十的陸地與海洋、改革五千億美元有害環境的補貼，以及復育受損的生態系統。儘管野生動植物正以驚人的速度消逝，但各國政府自 1992 年里約協議制定以來，卻連一項自然目標都未能達成。

grammar.point: 名詞子句作受詞 (Noun Clause as Object)
grammar.explain: 由連接詞 that 所引導的名詞子句置於動詞 revealed 之後，作為其直接受詞。
grammar.example: A new scientific study has revealed that most of Europe's wild bee species and roughly half of its hover fly species have declined over the past hundred years.
grammar.focus: that most of Europe's wild bee species and roughly half of its hover fly species have declined over the past hundred years

grammar.point: 過去分詞片語作後置修飾 (Past Participle Phrase as Modifier)
grammar.explain: 過去分詞片語 known 與 held 用於後置修飾專有名詞 conference，表示被動意涵「被稱作…」與「在…舉行」。

grammar.focus: known as Cop17, held in Yerevan, Armenia

grammar.point: 不定詞表目的 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 不定詞片語 to assess 用來表示主要動作 have gathered 的目的，說明外交官齊聚是為了進行評估。

grammar.focus: to assess targets for this decade

lessons.title: Capybara pups at Manx zoo draw record crowds
lessons.title_zh: 曼島動物園的水豚寶寶吸引了破紀錄的人潮

paragraphs.en: Curraghs Wildlife Park on the Isle of Man experienced its most crowded October weekend in history following the birth of eight capybara babies. Two mothers gave birth just days apart, on September 26 and October 1. Park manager Kathleen Graham noted that the parking area was completely packed, comparing the atmosphere to a public holiday as crowds rushed to view the newborn rodents.
paragraphs.zh: 曼島的柯拉格野生動物園（Curraghs Wildlife Park）在八隻水豚寶寶出生後，迎來了有史以來最擁擠的十月週末。兩隻水豚媽媽僅相隔數天生產，分別於9月26日和10月1日分娩。園區經理凱瑟琳．格雷厄姆（Kathleen Graham）指出停車場完全客滿，並將這種氛圍比作國定假日，因為大批民眾紛紛湧入觀看這些新生的齧齒動物。

paragraphs.en: This event represents an important milestone for the wildlife park, which had seen only one capybara birth during the previous four years. Capybaras come from South America and hold the title of the largest rodents on Earth, naturally flourishing in wet marshlands. After images of the young animals were shared across social media networks, public excitement rose rapidly, resulting in an unexpected surge in ticket sales and visitors.
paragraphs.zh: 這場盛事代表了該野生動物園的一座重要里程碑，該園在過去四年間僅迎來過一隻水豚誕生。水豚源自南美洲，擁有地球上最大齧齒動物的頭銜，並在潮濕的沼澤環境中繁衍茁壯。在這些幼獸的影像於社群媒體網路上分享之後，大眾的熱情迅速高漲，導致門票銷售與遊客數量出現意料之外的激增。

paragraphs.en: Although capybaras are not currently facing extinction, park staff emphasized that the species serves an essential educational purpose. The park is situated on a Ramsar-designated wetland and participates in a conservation campaign managed by the European Association of Zoos and Aquaria (EAZA). Graham explained that these natural wetlands function as systems that soak up heavy rainwater, making their protection crucial for wild animals and human communities alike.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管水豚目前並未面臨絕種，園區工作人員強調該物種具有至關重要的教育功能。該公園坐落於拉姆薩公約（Ramsar）指定的濕地上，並參與由歐洲動物園暨水族館協會（EAZA）所主導的保育活動。格雷厄姆解釋，這些天然濕地具備吸收大量雨水之系統的功能，使得對它們的保護無論對野生動物或人類社區而言都至關重要。

paragraphs.en: The sudden rise in visitors also provided direct financial aid for environmental efforts. Each guest gives one pound to the conservation fund unless they choose not to take part. This money aids local projects with the Manx Wildlife Trust as well as global initiatives in South America's Pantanal region. Graham added that the babies gave people welcome relief during difficult times, describing the arrival as a "super overload of cuteness really."
paragraphs.zh: 遊客數量的突然增加也為環境工作提供了直接的資金援助。每位遊客都會向保育基金捐出1英鎊，除非他們選擇不參與。這筆款項資助了曼島野生動物信託（Manx Wildlife Trust）的在地計畫，以及南美洲潘塔納爾（Pantanal）地區的全球專案。格雷厄姆補充說，這些小寶寶在艱難時刻為人們帶來了令人欣慰的寬慰，並將牠們的到來形容為「真的是超級可愛爆表」。

grammar.point: 非限定關係子句 (Non-restrictive Relative Clause)
grammar.explain: 先行詞為 the wildlife park，逗號後使用關係代名詞 which 引導非限定關係子句，為先行詞提供補充說明。
grammar.example: This event represents an important milestone for the wildlife park, which had seen only one capybara birth during the previous four years.
grammar.focus: which had seen only one capybara birth during the previous four years

grammar.point: 讓步副詞子句 (Adverbial Clause of Concession)
grammar.explain: 由從屬連接詞 Although 引導讓步副詞子句，語意為「雖然、儘管」，用以修飾後方的主要子句。
grammar.example: Although capybaras are not currently facing extinction, park staff emphasized that the species serves an essential educational purpose.
grammar.focus: Although capybaras are not currently facing extinction

grammar.point: 分詞構句 (Participle Construction)
grammar.explain: 逗號後省略連接詞並使用現在分詞 resulting 引導分詞構句，用來表示主要子句動作自然引發的後續結果。
grammar.example: After images of the young animals were shared across social media networks, public excitement rose rapidly, resulting in an unexpected surge in ticket sales and visitors.
grammar.focus: , resulting in an unexpected surge in ticket sales and visitors

lessons.title: Mars’ two tiny moons shouldn’t exist. A new mission has launched to reveal their secrets
lessons.title_zh: 火星的兩顆微小衛星本不該存在。一項新任務已發射升空以揭開它們的祕密

paragraphs.en: A groundbreaking space mission has recently launched to investigate Mars' two mysterious moons, Phobos and Deimos. Although scientists have observed these strange, lumpy objects for decades, their true origin remains an unsolved riddle. The Japanese-led Martian Moons eXploration (MMX) mission aims to study these bodies closely and collect samples directly from Phobos to uncover their long-standing cosmic secrets.
paragraphs.zh: 一項開創性的太空任務最近發射升空，以調查火星的兩顆神祕衛星：火衛一（Phobos）與火衛二（Deimos）。雖然科學家數十年來一直在觀察這些形狀不規則的奇特天體，但它們真正的起源仍然是一個未解之謎。由日本主導的「火星衛星探測」（MMX）任務旨在密切研究這些星體，並直接從火衛一採集樣本，以揭開它們長久以來的宇宙祕密。

paragraphs.en: The MMX spacecraft lifted off aboard an H3 rocket from the Tanegashima Space Center in southwestern Japan. This challenging mission is an international collaboration that includes scientific instruments from space agencies in the United States, Europe, France, and Germany. If successful, the spacecraft will deliver more than ten grams of collected material back to Earth in 2031, potentially making it the first mission to bring Martian material home.
paragraphs.zh: MMX 太空船從日本西南部的種子島宇宙中心搭乘 H3 火箭升空。這項艱巨的任務是一項國際合作計畫，包含來自美國、歐洲、法國和德國太空機構的科學儀器。如果一切順利，該太空船將於 2031 年將超過十公克採集到的物質帶回地球，這可能使其成為首個將火星物質帶回地球的任務。

paragraphs.en: American astronomer Asaph Hall first discovered both moons in 1877. Today, scientists are evaluating two major hypotheses about how they formed. One theory suggests that a massive impact on Mars launched rocky debris that later gathered together into moons. The other hypothesis proposes that they are stray asteroids pulled in by the gravity of Mars. As NASA scientist Dr. Abigail Fraeman noted, "They shouldn’t exist, but they do."
paragraphs.zh: 美國天文學家阿薩夫．霍爾（Asaph Hall）於 1877 年首次發現了這兩顆衛星。如今，科學家正在評估關於它們如何形成的兩大假說。一種理論認為，火星遭受巨大撞擊後噴射出岩石碎片，這些碎片隨後聚集成了衛星。另一種假說則主張，它們是被火星重力吸引過來的流浪小行星。正如美國國家航空暨太空總署（NASA）科學家艾比蓋爾．弗雷曼（Dr. Abigail Fraeman）博士所指出的：「它們本不該存在，但它們確實存在。」

paragraphs.en: Before touching down, the spacecraft will deploy a small robotic rover named Idefix to test the low-gravity surface and scout safe landing locations. The lander will then visit two distinct sites on Phobos, using a drill and gas equipment to gather surface dust and underground rocks. Scientists believe these valuable samples will illuminate the formation of the moons and support future human exploration of Mars.
paragraphs.zh: 在著陸之前，太空船將釋放一輛名為「伊德菲克斯」（Idefix）的小型機器探測車，以測試微弱重力的地表並勘察安全的著陸點。接著，著陸器將造訪火衛一上的兩個不同地點，利用鑽頭與氣體設備收集地表塵埃和地下岩石。科學家相信，這些珍貴的樣本將闡明這些衛星的形成過程，並為未來的火星載人探索提供支援。

grammar.point: 讓步副詞子句 (Adverbial Clause of Concession)
grammar.explain: 由連接詞 although 引導副詞子句，表示「雖然、儘管」，用以對比後方主要子句的內容。
grammar.example: Although scientists have observed these strange, lumpy objects for decades, their true origin remains an unsolved riddle.
grammar.focus: Although scientists have observed these strange, lumpy objects for decades

grammar.point: 關係代名詞引導的形容詞子句 (Relative Clause with Relative Pronoun)
grammar.explain: 關係代名詞 that 在子句中作主詞，指稱先行詞 rocky debris，並引導形容詞子句修飾該名詞。
grammar.example: One theory suggests that a massive impact on Mars launched rocky debris that later gathered together into moons.
grammar.focus: that later gathered together into moons

grammar.point: 不定詞表目的 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 不定詞片語在此處作副詞，用來說明釋放小型探測車的主要目的。
grammar.example: Before touching down, the spacecraft will deploy a small robotic rover named Idefix to test the low-gravity surface and scout safe landing locations.
grammar.focus: to test the low-gravity surface and scout safe landing locations

lessons.title: Russian satellite makes possibly unprecedented approach to another spacecraft without permission
lessons.title_zh: 俄羅斯衛星未經許可接近另一太空載具 恐創下前所未有的先例

paragraphs.en: In mid-October, a Russian satellite named Kosmos 2612 carried out a rare and unexpected maneuver in space. It moved unusually close to Iceye-X36, a commercial Earth-observation spacecraft. According to space tracking firm LeoLabs, the Russian satellite closed its distance from 350 kilometers down to less than 5 kilometers between October 15 and October 16. During part of the event, it may have even approached within roughly 500 meters.
paragraphs.zh: 十月中旬，一顆名為「宇宙 2612」（Kosmos 2612）的俄羅斯衛星在太空中進行了一次罕見且出乎意料的操作。它異常接近名為 Iceye-X36 的商業地球觀測太空載具。根據太空追蹤公司 LeoLabs 的說法，這顆俄羅斯衛星在 10 月 15 日至 10 月 16 日之間，將兩者間的距離從 350 公里縮小到不到 5 公里。在整個事件的某些階段中，它甚至可能已接近到大約 500 公尺的範圍內。

paragraphs.en: Astrophysicist Jonathan McDowell pointed out that while spacecraft often meet or dock in orbit, this action could mark the first time one spacecraft has approached another without permission. The target satellite, Iceye-X36, is operated by a multinational company named Iceye. The firm utilizes advanced radar technology to produce sharp images day or night, regardless of weather conditions. Furthermore, Iceye has an agreement to assist the Ukrainian military with continuous situational awareness.
paragraphs.zh: 天體物理學家喬納森．麥克道威（Jonathan McDowell）指出，儘管太空載具在軌道上會合或對接經常發生，但此一行動可能標誌著有太空載具首次在未經許可的情況下接近另一艘載具。目標衛星 Iceye-X36 由一家名為 Iceye 的跨國公司營運。該公司利用先進的雷達技術，無論天候狀況如何，都能在白天或夜晚生成清晰的影像。此外，Iceye 簽有協議，為烏克蘭軍隊提供持續的態勢感知支援。

paragraphs.en: Experts had noticed suspicious movements months earlier. A June report from the Royal United Services Institute (RUSI), a defense research organization in the United Kingdom, revealed that four Russian-controlled satellites had already adjusted their paths to align with Iceye-X36 since May. Over the weekend, Kosmos 2612 made minor adjustments to maintain its close position before it finally began to pull away on Monday.
paragraphs.zh: 專家早在數個月前就注意到了可疑的動向。總部位於英國的國防研究機構皇家聯合軍事研究所（RUSI）在 6 月發布的一份報告顯示，自 5 月以來，已有四顆俄羅斯控制的衛星調整軌道以與 Iceye-X36 保持一致。在整個週末期間，Kosmos 2612 進行了微調以維持其接近位置，直到週一才終於開始移開。

paragraphs.en: Although LeoLabs stated that the maneuver does not confirm hostile intent, the event demonstrated capabilities that could support intelligence gathering, inspection, or interference. RUSI warned that such maneuvers could serve as intimidation or attempts to disrupt communication through radio noise, known as jamming. Meanwhile, Iceye stated that its satellite network is designed for continuity, and LeoLabs emphasized that "the behavior warrants continued monitoring."
paragraphs.zh: 儘管 LeoLabs 表示該項操作並不能確立敵對意圖，但這項事件展現了可用於支援情報蒐集、檢查或干擾的能力。RUSI 警告，此類機動動作可能作為恐嚇手段，或試圖透過被稱為「干擾」（jamming）的無線電雜訊來阻斷通訊。與此同時，Iceye 表示其衛星網絡旨在維持連續性，而 LeoLabs 則強調「這種行為值得持續監控」。

grammar.point: 不定詞表目的 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: to maintain 為不定詞片語，在此作副詞修飾動詞片語 made minor adjustments，用以說明「做出微調的目的」。
grammar.example: Over the weekend, Kosmos 2612 made minor adjustments to maintain its close position before it finally began to pull away on Monday.
grammar.focus: to maintain its close position

grammar.point: 讓步副詞子句 (Adverb Clause of Concession)
grammar.explain: 從屬連接詞 Although 引導表示「雖然、儘管」的副詞子句，用來說明與主要子句形成對比的背景事實。
grammar.example: Although LeoLabs stated that the maneuver does not confirm hostile intent, the event demonstrated capabilities that could support intelligence gathering, inspection, or interference.
grammar.focus: Although LeoLabs stated that the maneuver does not confirm hostile intent

grammar.point: 過去完成式 (Past Perfect Tense)
grammar.explain: 以 had + 過去分詞 adjusted 構成過去完成式，用來表示在過去某個事件（6 月報告揭露）之前就已發生的動作。
grammar.example: A June report from the Royal United Services Institute (RUSI), a defense research organization in the United Kingdom, revealed that four Russian-controlled satellites had already adjusted their paths to align with Iceye-X36 since May.
grammar.focus: had already adjusted

lessons.title: ‘Tariff Man’ finally found tariffs he doesn’t like
lessons.title_zh: 「關稅人」終於找到了他不喜歡的關稅

paragraphs.en: President Donald Trump has long celebrated his love for taxes on foreign goods, even nicknaming himself "Tariff Man." During his presidency, he repeatedly raised trade barriers against both allies and rivals to protect American manufacturing. Yet, when faced with imposing extremely harsh trade penalties on Russia, Trump unexpectedly chose to pull back.
paragraphs.zh: 唐納·川普總統長期以來一直讚揚自己對外國商品徵稅的熱愛，甚至給自己取了「關稅人」的綽號。在總統任期內，他多次對盟友與對手提高貿易壁壘，以保護美國製造業。然而，當面臨對俄羅斯實施極為嚴厲的貿易懲罰時，川普卻出人意料地選擇了退縮。

paragraphs.en: On Friday, Trump signed an executive order that suspended tough new tariffs and sanctions against Russia only two days before they took effect. These measures had been included in a bill named after the late Republican senator Lindsey Graham. The order temporarily halts tariffs of up to 500 percent on Russian imports and 100 percent on the top five nations that import Russian oil and natural gas.
paragraphs.zh: 週五，川普簽署了一項行政命令，在對俄羅斯的嚴厲新關稅與制裁即將生效的僅僅兩天前將其暫緩。這些措施原本包含在一項以已故共和黨參議員林賽·葛蘭姆命名的法案中。該命令暫時停止了對俄羅斯進口商品高達 500% 的關稅，以及對進口俄羅斯石油和天然氣前五大國家的 100% 關稅。

paragraphs.en: This decision triggered immediate backlash from both political parties. Ed Mills, a policy analyst at Raymond James, warned that the move seriously weakens the enforcement of the Graham sanctions act. Outgoing Republican Senator Thom Tillis condemned the waiver, calling the step "beyond irresponsible." Senator Darline Graham, who holds her late brother's seat, also disagreed with Trump, stating that high pressure must remain on Russia. Meanwhile, Kirill Dmitriev, who leads Russia's sovereign wealth fund, praised the suspension.
paragraphs.zh: 這項決定立即引發了兩黨的強烈反彈。雷蒙詹姆斯金融公司的政策分析師艾德·米爾斯警告，此舉嚴重削弱了葛蘭姆制裁法案的執行力。即將卸任的共和黨參議員湯姆·提里斯譴責了這項豁免，稱此舉「極其不負責任」。接替已故兄長席位的參議員達琳·葛蘭姆也不同意川普的做法，表示必須對俄羅斯維持高壓。與此同時，領導俄羅斯主權財富基金的基里爾·德米特里耶夫則對該暫緩措施表示讚賞。

paragraphs.en: In the energy sector, the announcement offered only minor relief to high prices. Brent crude oil stayed near 110 dollars per barrel as analysts questioned how much additional fuel would reach the market. Defending the president, Secretary of State Marco Rubio stated that the government requires a sixty-day period to examine the economic consequences. Rubio pointed out that the sanctions would also hurt trade partners like India, making a careful review necessary for the global economy.
paragraphs.zh: 在能源領域，這項公告僅為高昂的價格帶來了微弱的緩解。布蘭特原油價格維持在每桶 110 美元左右，因為分析師質疑會有多少額外的燃料流入市場。國務卿馬克·盧比歐在為總統辯護時表示，政府需要六十天的時間來檢視這項經濟後果。盧比歐指出，這些制裁也會傷害像印度這樣的貿易夥伴，因此為了全球經濟，仔細審視是有必要的。

grammar.point: 關係代名詞引導的形容詞子句 (Relative clause with relative pronoun)
grammar.explain: 關係代名詞 that 在此引導形容詞子句，修飾前面的先行詞 an executive order。
grammar.example: On Friday, Trump signed an executive order that suspended tough new tariffs and sanctions against Russia only two days before they took effect.
grammar.focus: that suspended tough new tariffs and sanctions against Russia only two days before they took effect

grammar.point: 不定詞表目的 (Infinitive of purpose)
grammar.explain: 不定詞片語 to examine... 在句中表示目的，說明需要六十天這段期間是為了達成何種目標。
grammar.example: Defending the president, Secretary of State Marco Rubio stated that the government requires a sixty-day period to examine the economic consequences.
grammar.focus: to examine the economic consequences

lessons.title: Amelia Earhart mystery continues as researchers unravel identity of the Taraia Object
lessons.title_zh: 隨著研究人員揭開塔萊亞物體的身分，愛蜜莉亞．艾爾哈特之謎仍在延續

paragraphs.en: A team of seventeen researchers and technicians recently traveled to Nikumaroro Island, an isolated atoll in the South Pacific, to look for the remains of Amelia Earhart’s missing plane. However, the expedition returned without discovering any definitive evidence that the famous aviator ever landed there.
paragraphs.zh: 一組由十七名研究人員與技術人員組成的團隊最近前往南太平洋的一座偏遠環礁——尼庫馬羅羅島，尋找愛蜜莉亞．艾爾哈特失蹤飛機的殘骸。然而，這次探險無功而返，並未發現任何這名著名飛行員曾降落於該處的決定性證據。

paragraphs.en: The journey was organized by the Archaeological Legacy Institute (ALI) and Purdue University. Their primary objective was to inspect an unusual shape in a lagoon, known as the Taraia Object. First detected in satellite pictures in 2020, the figure appeared to be airplane wreckage. Yet, on-site investigation revealed that it was merely a cluster of large trees, and much of the debris had already broken into pieces and washed away.
paragraphs.zh: 這趟旅程由考古遺產研究所（ALI）與普渡大學共同籌辦。他們的主要目標是檢查潟湖中一個被稱為「塔萊亞物體」的異常形狀。該物體於2020年首次在衛星影像中被偵測到，外觀看似飛機殘骸。然而，現場調查顯示它只不過是一堆大樹，且大部分殘骸早已碎裂並被沖走。

paragraphs.en: Even so, researchers still believe Earhart and her navigator, Fred Noonan, might have reached the island. Steve Schultz, a Purdue general counsel and field assistant, noted that ruling out the object "doesn’t detract from the existing, very strong, compelling case" for the castaway theory.
paragraphs.zh: 即便如此，研究人員仍然認為艾爾哈特和她的領航員佛列德．努南可能已經抵達該島。普渡大學總法律顧問兼現場助理史蒂夫．舒爾茲指出，排除該物體「絲毫不減損現有非常有力且具說服力的論據」，該論據支持遇難流落荒島的假說。

paragraphs.en: Earhart disappeared on July 2, 1937, during her brave attempt to become the first woman to fly around the globe. The pair were last seen taking off from Lae, New Guinea, heading toward Howland Island. While official government records suggested that their aircraft ran out of fuel and sank into the ocean, some experts suspect they survived as castaways on Nikumaroro until they died of hunger or thirst.
paragraphs.zh: 艾爾哈特於1937年7月2日在勇敢嘗試成為首位環球飛行的女性時失蹤。兩人最後一次被看見是在新幾內亞的萊城起飛，前往豪蘭島。雖然官方政府紀錄推測他們的飛機耗盡燃料並沉入大洋，但一些專家懷疑他們在尼庫馬羅羅島作為遇難流落者生存了下來，直到因飢渴而喪生。

paragraphs.en: Over the decades, more than fifteen searches around Nikumaroro have ended in disappointment, including an expedition in 2019 led by oceanographer Bob Ballard. Despite these repeated failures, efforts will persist. An exploration company named Nauticos is currently seeking funds to launch another deep-sea mission near Howland Island, hoping to finally solve aviation history's greatest mystery.
paragraphs.zh: 幾十年來，尼庫馬羅羅島周圍超過十五次的搜尋皆以失望告終，包括2019年由海洋學家鮑勃．巴拉德率領的探險。儘管屢次失敗，各方的努力仍將持續。一家名為 Nauticos 的探勘公司目前正尋求資金，以在豪蘭島附近展開另一場深海任務，希望能最終解開航空史上最大的謎團。

vocab.zh: 令人信服的；很有說服力的

grammar.point: 不定詞表目的 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 不定詞片語在句中作副詞修飾主要動詞 traveled，用來表示該行動的目的（為了尋找飛機殘骸）。
grammar.example: A team of seventeen researchers and technicians recently traveled to Nikumaroro Island, an isolated atoll in the South Pacific, to look for the remains of Amelia Earhart’s missing plane.
grammar.focus: to look for the remains of Amelia Earhart’s missing plane

grammar.point: 動名詞當主詞 (Gerund as Subject)
grammar.explain: 在 that 引導的名詞子句中，動名詞片語 ruling out the object 作為子句主詞，視為單數並搭配助動詞 doesn't。
grammar.example: Steve Schultz, a Purdue general counsel and field assistant, noted that ruling out the object "doesn’t detract from the existing, very strong, compelling case" for the castaway theory.
grammar.focus: ruling out the object

grammar.point: 分詞構句 (Participle Construction)
grammar.explain: 現在分詞片語 hoping 引導的分詞構句，省略了連接詞與相同主詞，用來補充說明主詞 Nauticos 同時抱持的期盼。
grammar.example: An exploration company named Nauticos is currently seeking funds to launch another deep-sea mission near Howland Island, hoping to finally solve aviation history's greatest mystery.
grammar.focus: , hoping to finally solve aviation history's greatest mystery

lessons.title: Victoria’s Secret reboots its fantasy with a $50M diamond bra
lessons.title_zh: 維多利亞的秘密以五千萬美元鑽石胸罩重啟其奇幻魅力

paragraphs.en: Victoria's Secret recently hosted its annual fashion show, featuring a stunning appearance by Kylie Jenner in a remarkably expensive diamond brasserie. The luxury jewelry company Jacob and Company designed the special bustier using ninety-one large white diamonds and one massive yellow diamond at the center. This expensive piece represents a major financial investment for the lingerie brand as it works to move past previous public criticism and financial losses.
paragraphs.zh: 維多利亞的秘密最近舉辦了年度時尚秀，其中凱莉·珍娜身穿一件極其昂貴的鑽石胸罩驚豔登場，成為全場焦點。高級珠寶公司賈克寶使用九十一顆大型白鑽以及正中央一顆巨大的黃鑽，設計出這款特別的馬甲胸衣。這件昂貴的作品代表了該內衣品牌的一項重大財務投資，因為它正努力擺脫先前的公眾批評與財務虧損。

paragraphs.en: A large group of celebrities attended the event to watch famous models walk the runway. The show included both veteran catwalkers and newer models wearing a variety of delicate floral wings and sportier lingerie. Several musical acts performed live music during the runway presentations, adding to the energy of the large-scale event.
paragraphs.zh: 一大群名人出席了這場活動，觀賞著名的模特兒們走伸展台。這場秀包含了資深貓步模特兒以及較新的模特兒，她們身穿各種精緻的花朵翅膀與運動風內衣。數個音樂表演團體在伸展台展示期間進行現場演唱，為這場大型活動增添了活力。

paragraphs.en: In addition to established stars, the brand introduced the winner of its new social media reality competition series. This online show aimed to find a fresh face for the runway through an open casting process held in malls across the United States. Thousands of people applied for the chance, and the first episode quickly gained millions of views online, showing strong public interest in the company.
paragraphs.zh: 除了已經成名的明星之外，該品牌還介紹了其全新社群媒體實境競賽系列節目的優勝者。這個網路節目的目的是透過在全美各地購物中心舉辦的公開徵選過程，為伸展台尋找一張新面孔。數千人申請爭取這個機會，而第一集在網路上迅速獲得數百萬觀看次數，顯示出大眾對該公司的濃厚興趣。

paragraphs.en: The brand's chief creative officer has spent recent months dealing with the company's complicated history and past controversies. Previous shows faced criticism for promoting only one narrow body type, but recent events have included a wider variety of models to improve diversity. This careful balance between traditional glamour and modern social attitudes has helped improve the company's market position and share price.
paragraphs.zh: 該品牌的首席創意官花費了最近幾個月的時間來處理該公司複雜的歷史與過去的爭議。先前的服裝秀因只推廣單一狹隘的身材類型而面臨批評，但最近的活動已經納入了更多樣化的模特兒以提升多元性。這種在傳統魅力與現代社會態度之間的謹慎平衡，有助於改善公司的市場地位與股價。

grammar.point: 分詞構句 (Participial Construction)
grammar.explain: 說明主句伴隨發生的動作或結果，以V-ing分詞片語引導補充說明。
grammar.example: This expensive piece represents a major financial investment for the lingerie brand as it works to move past previous public criticism and financial losses.
grammar.focus: as it works to move past previous public criticism and financial losses

grammar.point: 不定詞作目的副詞片語 (Infinitive Phrase of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 使用 to 加原形動詞來表達做出某個動作的目的（為了……）。
grammar.example: This online show aimed to find a fresh face for the runway through an open casting process held in malls across the United States.
grammar.focus: to find a fresh face for the runway

grammar.point: 過去分詞作形容詞用 (Past Participle as Adjective)
grammar.explain: 使用過去分詞來修飾名詞，表示被動或完成的狀態。
grammar.example: Previous shows faced criticism for promoting only one narrow body type, but recent events have included a wider variety of models to improve diversity.
grammar.focus: Previous shows

lessons.title: Elon Musk says he will give a SpaceX share to ‘every kid in America’
lessons.title_zh: 馬斯克表示他將贈送SpaceX股份給「美國每一個小孩」

paragraphs.en: Elon Musk announced on Monday that he will give a share of his aerospace and artificial intelligence company, SpaceX, to every child in America next year. This proposal follows growing scrutiny and criticism faced by major technology firms regarding their social impact. SpaceX began trading publicly in June following a major initial public offering, with shares closing around 146 US dollars on Friday.
paragraphs.zh: 伊隆·馬斯克（Elon Musk）於週一宣布，他將在明年把他的航太與人工智慧公司 SpaceX 的一股，贈送給美國的每一個兒童。這項提議是在大型科技公司因其社會影響而面臨日益增加的審查與批評之際提出的。SpaceX 在進行了一次大型首次公開募股後，於六月開始公開交易，週五收盤時每股股價約為 146 美元。

paragraphs.en: However, the proposal lacks specific details. It remains unclear how these shares will be distributed to millions of children or whether all minors will actually be eligible. According to the United States Census Bureau, there are approximately 73 million individuals under the age of 18. Based on the current share price, this potential giveaway could cost about 10.7 billion US dollars.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，該提議缺乏具體細節。目前尚不清楚這些股份將如何分配給數百萬名兒童，或是所有未成年人是否真的具備資格。根據美國人口普查局的資料，18 歲以下的人口大約有 7,300 萬人。根據目前的股價計算，這項潛在的贈送活動價值約達 107 億美元。

paragraphs.en: Giving young people a stake in the stock market is not an entirely new concept. The Treasury Department recently launched a federal savings vehicle for children born between 2025 and 2028, offering a one-time government contribution. Additionally, SpaceX President Gwynne Shotwell and her husband previously pledged to donate one company share each to about two million children already signed up for an account, prioritizing lower-income households.
paragraphs.zh: 讓年輕人擁有股票市場的股權並非完全全新的概念。財政部最近為 2025 年至 2028 年間出生的兒童推出了聯邦儲蓄工具，提供一次性的政府提撥金。此外，SpaceX 總裁格溫恩·肖特韋爾（Gwynne Shotwell）與她的丈夫先前曾承諾，要各捐贈一股公司股份給大約兩00萬名已經註冊帳戶的兒童，並優先考慮低收入家庭。

paragraphs.en: Musk made his offer shortly after Anthropic announced it would dedicate at least five percent of its shares to a fund supporting social causes. Musk criticized traditional philanthropy, stating that giving money away to achieve the reality of goodness is very difficult. Both offers emerge as artificial intelligence companies face severe backlash over safety, potential job losses, and the heavy environmental impact of massive data center construction.
paragraphs.zh: 馬斯克提出這項贈送是在 Anthropic 宣布將把至少百分之五的股份投入支持社會公益的基金不久之後。馬斯克批評了傳統的慈善事業，並表示要為了達到良善的現實而捐出金錢是非常困難的。這兩項提議出現之際，人工智慧公司正因安全性、潛在的工作流失以及大規模資料中心建設帶來的沉重環境衝擊，而面臨嚴重的強烈反彈。

paragraphs.en: Furthermore, recent films and documentaries are reminding the public of the long-standing recklessness found within the tech industry. Musk is also the subject of a new documentary that openly examines his career and political activities. As tech companies navigate these challenges, leaders continue to seek new ways to address public concerns.
paragraphs.zh: 此外，近期的電影與紀錄片正在提醒大眾關於科技產業內部長期存在的魯莽行為。馬斯克也是一部公開檢視其職業生涯與政治活動的新紀錄片的主角。隨著科技公司應對這些挑戰，領導者們持續尋找新的方法來解決大眾的擔憂。

grammar.point: 被動語態 (Passive Voice)
grammar.explain: 用來強調動作的承受者，結構為 be 動詞加上過去分詞。
grammar.example: It remains unclear how these shares will be distributed to millions of children or whether all minors will actually be eligible.
grammar.focus: will be distributed

grammar.point: 分詞構句 (Participle Construction)
grammar.explain: 使用現在分詞 V-ing 來表達附帶狀況或同時發生的動作。
grammar.example: Elon Musk announced on Monday that he will give a share of his aerospace and artificial intelligence company, SpaceX, to every child in America next year.
grammar.focus: SpaceX

lessons.title: So you say you hate ‘surveillance pricing’
lessons.title_zh: 所以你說你討厭「監視定價」

paragraphs.en: Consumers worry that companies are using personal data to charge more for everyday items. In response to this public concern, lawmakers in places like Colorado passed a bill to ban individualized pricing based on search history and income. However, the governor vetoed the measure because it could accidentally prevent shoppers from getting discounts and lower prices.
paragraphs.zh: 消費者擔心企業正在利用個人資料對日常用品收取更高費用。為了回應這種公眾擔憂，像是科羅拉多州等地的立法者通過了一項法案，禁止根據搜尋紀錄和收入來進行個人化定價。然而，州長否決了這項措施，因為它可能會意外地阻止消費者獲得折扣和更低的價格。

paragraphs.en: Public anger over high prices and data collection has led to growing pressure on companies. Many cities and states are considering restrictions on how businesses set prices, especially in grocery stores and fast-food chains. Some unions even support banning electronic shelf labels because they fear technology will replace human workers who change paper tags.
paragraphs.zh: 大眾對於高物價與資料收集的憤怒，導致對企業的壓力不斷增加。許多城市和州正在考慮限制企業設定價格的方式，特別是在雜貨店和速食連鎖店中。一些工會甚至支持禁止電子貨架標籤，因為他們擔心科技會取代更換紙質標籤的人類勞工。

paragraphs.en: Yet experts point out a major contradiction in these total bans. The same digital tool that allows companies to adjust prices can also create benefits for buyers by reducing food waste and offering cheaper options during slow hours. Researchers state that electronic labels do not increase overall prices, and broad laws might actually harm consumers instead of protecting them.
paragraphs.zh: 然而專家指出這些全面禁令中存在一個重大矛盾。允許企業調整價格的同一種數位工具，也可以透過減少食物浪費並在離峰時段提供更便宜的選擇來為買家創造好處。研究人員表示，電子標籤並不會提高整體價格，廣泛的法律實際上可能會傷害消費者而非保護他們。

paragraphs.en: Experts explain that people often confuse dynamic pricing with personalized pricing. Dynamic pricing adjusts costs based on market supply and demand, a practice used for decades in airlines and restaurants. Studies show that dynamic pricing helps businesses offer lower fares or attract customers during slow periods, bringing down the average cost without raising overall prices.
paragraphs.zh: 專家解釋人們經常將動態定價與個人化定價混淆。動態定價根據市場供需來調整成本，這是在航空業和餐飲業已使用了數十年的做法。研究顯示，動態定價有助於企業提供更便宜的票價或在淡季吸引客戶，在不提高整體價格的情況下降低平均成本。

paragraphs.en: As artificial intelligence expands pricing options, politicians like Senators Elizabeth Warren and Bernie Sanders claim that the technology drives up costs. Meanwhile, companies such as Walmart face public criticism over potential future practices. However, Walmart defended its strategy by stating that it relies on stable prices and wants to keep shoppers happy rather than risk losing business over small amounts.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著人工智慧擴大定價選擇，像是參議員伊莉莎白·華倫和伯尼·桑德斯等政治人物聲稱該技術推高了成本。同時，沃爾瑪等公司因潛在的未來做法而面臨公眾批評。然而，沃爾瑪為其策略辯護，表示它依賴穩定的價格，並希望讓購物者保持滿意，而不是冒著為了一小筆金額而失去業務的風險。

grammar.point: 關係代名詞 (Relative Pronoun)
grammar.explain: 說明先行詞 tools，用以引導形容詞子句修飾前面的名詞。
grammar.example: The same digital tool that allows companies to adjust prices can also create benefits for buyers by reducing food waste and offering cheaper options during slow hours.
grammar.focus: that allows companies to adjust prices

grammar.point: 表目的之不定詞 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 使用 to 加原形動詞來表達做某事的目的（為了……）。
grammar.example: However, Walmart defended its strategy by stating that it relies on stable prices and wants to keep shoppers happy rather than risk losing business over small amounts.
grammar.focus: to keep shoppers happy

lessons.title: A Kelvin wave raised sea levels on the West Coast. More are coming
lessons.title_zh: 開爾文波推升了美西海岸的海平面，而且未來還會有更多

paragraphs.en: One of the earliest signs of a powerful El Niño has appeared on the United States West Coast. It is a deep ocean phenomenon known as a Kelvin wave, which is actively pushing up sea levels along the shoreline. Although scientists have studied these waves for decades, videos explaining the event have recently attracted wide public interest on social media platforms like TikTok and X.
paragraphs.zh: 強烈「聖嬰現象」（El Niño）的最早跡象之一已經出現在美國西岸。這是一種被稱為開爾文波（Kelvin wave）的深海現象，它目前正推升沿岸的海平面。儘管科學家研究這些海浪已有數十年之久，但解釋該現象的影片最近在 TikTok 與 X 等社群媒體平台上引起了大眾廣泛的關注。

paragraphs.en: A Kelvin wave starts along the equator during El Niño years, when vast regions of the Pacific Ocean become unusually warm. Deep under the surface, this warm water travels eastward across thousands of miles until it hits South America. Once it arrives, the wave divides into two paths, moving north toward North America and south toward Chile. Dillon Amaya, an atmospheric sciences professor at North Carolina State University, noted that "it's a planetary-scale wave" rather than a visible surfing wave or tsunami.
paragraphs.zh: 在聖嬰現象發生的年份，當太平洋的大片區域變得異常溫暖時，開爾文波便會在赤道沿線形成。在海面深處，這些溫水跨越數千英里向東移動，直到抵達南美洲。一旦抵達，海浪便分流為兩條路徑，向北朝北美移動，並向南朝智利前進。北卡羅來納州立大學（North Carolina State University）大氣科學助理教授狄倫．阿瑪亞（Dillon Amaya）指出，「這是一個行星尺度的波（it's a planetary-scale wave）」，而非肉眼可見的衝浪浪潮或海嘯。

paragraphs.en: While Kelvin waves do not create floods alone, they increase flood risks by elevating the sea level. Scientists describe dangerous situations where El Niño, high tides, and coastal storms strike at the exact same moment. For instance, in early October, Southern California saw ocean levels rise six to eight inches. When Tropical Storm Rachel arrived soon after, coastal homes were partially flooded because of the extra water height.
paragraphs.zh: 雖然開爾文波本身不會引發洪水，但它們透過提升海平面增加了洪水的風險。科學家形容，當聖嬰現象、滿潮與沿海風暴同時來襲時，會形成危險的局面。例如在十月初，南加州的海平面上升了六到八英吋。當熱帶風暴瑞秋（Tropical Storm Rachel）隨後抵達時，沿海房屋因為額外增加的水位而局部淹水。

paragraphs.en: In addition to flooding threats, these waves carry warmer water northward, which can severely disturb ocean life. Warmer temperatures push nutrient-rich cold waters downward, reducing food supplies for marine creatures. Researchers have already observed dying seabirds and spotted unusual tropical animals, such as a whale shark near San Diego.
paragraphs.zh: 除了洪水威脅之外，這些海浪還會將較溫暖的海水帶往北方，這可能會嚴重干擾海洋生態。較暖的水溫會將富含養分的冷水向下推擠，從而減少海洋生物的食物來源。研究人員已經觀察到海鳥死亡的現象，並在聖地牙哥附近發現了罕見的熱帶動物，例如一隻鯨鯊。

paragraphs.en: Strong El Niño events typically bring five to six Kelvin waves before weakening. Experts predict another wave will reach San Diego around late October or early November, followed by several more during early winter. Meanwhile, researchers from the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) expect this strong El Niño pattern to continue until early 2027.
paragraphs.zh: 在減弱之前，強烈的聖嬰現象通常會帶來五到六次開爾文波。專家預測下一波將在十月下旬或十一月上旬抵達聖地牙哥，隨後在初冬還會出現好幾波。同時，來自美國國家海洋暨大氣總署（NOAA）的研究人員預測，這種強烈的聖嬰現象型態將持續至 2027 年初。

grammar.point: 非限定關係代名詞子句 (Non-defining Relative Clause)
grammar.explain: 由「, which」引導非限定關係子句，修飾前方整個名詞片語「a Kelvin wave」，補充說明其目前造成的影響。
grammar.example: It is a deep ocean phenomenon known as a Kelvin wave, which is actively pushing up sea levels along the shoreline.
grammar.focus: which is actively pushing up sea levels along the shoreline

grammar.point: 時間副詞子句 (Adverbial Clause of Time)
grammar.explain: 由從屬連接詞「until」引導時間副詞子句，表示主要子句的動作持續進行「直到」某個特定時間點或事件發生為止。
grammar.example: Deep under the surface, this warm water travels eastward across thousands of miles until it hits South America.
grammar.focus: until it hits South America

grammar.point: 介系詞接動名詞表示方法 (Preposition + Gerund for Means)
grammar.explain: 介系詞「by」後接動名詞「elevating」，在此結構中用來具體表達達成主要子句動作的「手段或途徑」。
grammar.example: While Kelvin waves do not create floods alone, they increase flood risks by elevating the sea level.
grammar.focus: by elevating

lessons.title: Starwatch: Catch the Orionid meteor shower streak across the night sky
lessons.title_zh: 觀星指南：捕捉獵戶座流星雨劃過夜空的景象

paragraphs.en: Stargazers around the world have an exciting opportunity this week as the annual Orionid meteor shower reaches its peak. This celestial event gives sky watchers a special chance to view glowing fragments from Halley’s comet, which is widely considered the most famous comet in history, as they dash across the dark sky.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著一年一度的獵戶座流星雨在本週達到極大期，全球的天文愛好者迎來了一個令人興奮的機會。這場天文盛事為觀星者提供了一個難得的機會，能觀賞歷史上最著名彗星——哈雷彗星所產生的發光碎片劃過黑暗的夜空。

paragraphs.en: The Orionids take place every October when our planet travels through a trail of cosmic dust left behind by Halley’s comet. As these tiny space particles rush into Earth’s atmosphere at a speed of approximately 66 kilometres per second, they rub against and heat the surrounding air. This intense friction creates the brief, bright flashes of light that people observe as meteors.
paragraphs.zh: 獵戶座流星雨於每年十月發生，此時我們的地球會穿過哈雷彗星所留下的宇宙塵埃帶。當這些微小的太空顆粒以每秒約六十六公里的速度衝入地球大氣層時，它們會摩擦並加熱周圍的空氣。這種劇烈的摩擦產生了短暫而明亮的光芒，也就是人們所看到的流星。

paragraphs.en: This year, the astronomical display is predicted to hit its greatest activity during the night of 21 to 22 October. Under perfect viewing conditions, observers might be able to count between 10 and 20 meteors every hour. However, the viewing environment this year is far from perfect because of a bright waxing gibbous Moon, whose intense glow will unfortunately drown out many of the fainter shooting stars.
paragraphs.zh: 今年，這場天文景觀預計會在十月二十一日至二十二日的夜間達到活動最盛期。在理想的觀賞條件下，觀測者每小時可能可以數到十至二十顆流星。然而，由於一輪明亮的盈凸月出現，今年的觀賞環境並不理想，因為其強烈的光芒不幸地會掩蓋許多較暗的流星。

paragraphs.en: Even so, the situation becomes much better in the early hours before sunrise. The moon sets at around 03:00 British Summer Time (BST), which creates a window of darker skies for several hours prior to dawn. During this time, the constellation of Orion gradually rises high into the night sky, making the viewing experience significantly more rewarding.
paragraphs.zh: 即便如此，在日出前的清晨時分，情況會改善許多。月亮大約在英國夏令時間（BST）凌晨三點西沉，在破曉前留下了數小時較為黑暗的夜空。在這段時間內，獵戶座逐漸升高到夜空的高處，使得觀賞體驗大幅提升。

paragraphs.en: For those wishing to enjoy the sight, experts suggest finding a safe area that provides the widest possible view of the open sky. Special equipment like telescopes is not necessary, as the display can simply be viewed with the naked eye. In London, people looking towards the south-east at midnight on the night of 21 to 22 October can see the meteors, which appear to spread outwards from a location near Orion.
paragraphs.zh: 對於希望欣賞這項美景的人，專家建議尋找一個能提供最寬廣開闊天空視野的安全地點。像望遠鏡之類的特殊設備並非必要，因為用肉眼就能直接觀看這場盛宴。在倫敦，十月二十一日轉為二十二日午夜時分望向東南方的民眾，可以看到這些流星似乎從靠近獵戶座的位置向外散發出來。

grammar.point: 非限定關係子句 (Non-defining Relative Clause)
grammar.explain: 由逗號隔開的「which」引導非限定關係子句，用來對前方先行詞「Halley's comet」補充額外說明。
grammar.example: This celestial event gives sky watchers a special chance to view glowing fragments from Halley’s comet, which is widely considered the most famous comet in history, as they dash across the dark sky.
grammar.focus: , which is widely considered the most famous comet in history,

grammar.point: 現在分詞構句 (Participle Construction)
grammar.explain: 逗號後方使用現在分詞「making」，構成表示伴隨結果的分詞構句，說明獵戶座升起所帶來的效果。
grammar.example: During this time, the constellation of Orion gradually rises high into the night sky, making the viewing experience significantly more rewarding.
grammar.focus: , making the viewing experience significantly more rewarding

grammar.point: 被動語態 (Passive Voice)
grammar.explain: 由情態助動詞「can」搭配「be + 過去分詞（viewed）」組成，表示主詞「the display」能被觀賞的被動概念。
grammar.example: Special equipment like telescopes is not necessary, as the display can simply be viewed with the naked eye.
grammar.focus: can simply be viewed

lessons.title: Warning signs could predict inflammatory bowel disease a decade before diagnosis
lessons.title_zh: 血液中的警訊可能在發炎性腸道疾病確診十年前就預測出來

paragraphs.en: Recent research shows that patterns of antibodies in human blood could predict inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) up to a decade before a formal diagnosis. This discovery brings new hope for doctors to catch the chronic condition much earlier than before.
paragraphs.zh: 最新研究顯示，人類血液中的抗體模式可能在正式確診發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）長達十年前就預測出來。這項發現為醫生帶來了新的希望，能夠比以往更早發現這種慢性疾病。

paragraphs.en: Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis are the two main types of IBD. Usually, these conditions are treated only after visible symptoms appear and the gut is already harmed. However, scientists discovered that the immune system sends warning signals years ahead, creating a chance for earlier detection.
paragraphs.zh: 克隆氏症和潰瘍性結腸炎是發炎性腸道疾病的兩種主要類型。通常，這些疾病只有在明顯症狀出現且腸道已經受損後才會接受治療。然而，科學家發現免疫系統在數年前就會發送警告訊號，為更早檢測創造了機會。

paragraphs.en: Dr Arno Bourgonje from the University Medical Centre Groningen and the Icahn School of Medicine at Mount Sinai explained that the disease starts years before any signs show. At least 3.8 million people around the world live with IBD, which causes chronic digestive inflammation, pain, diarrhoea, and fatigue.
paragraphs.zh: 來自荷蘭格羅寧根大學醫學中心和紐約西奈山伊坎醫學院的阿諾·布爾岡傑博士解釋說，該疾病在任何徵兆出現的數年前就已經開始了。全球至少有 380 萬人罹患發炎性腸道疾病，該疾病會引起慢性的消化道發炎、疼痛、腹瀉和疲勞。

paragraphs.en: Researchers at Mount Sinai and the Medical University of Vienna tested blood samples from US military personnel. They studied 2,000 samples from 500 individuals, including people who later developed Crohn's disease or ulcerative colitis, as well as some who developed neither.
paragraphs.zh: 西奈山和維也納醫科大學的研究人員對美國軍事人員的血液樣本進行了測試。他們研究了來自 500 名個人的 2,000 個樣本，其中包括後來罹患克隆氏症或潰瘍性結腸炎的人，以及一些兩者皆未發作的人。

paragraphs.en: The tests revealed different antibody patterns for each condition. For instance, people who later developed Crohn's disease had common antibodies against the Epstein-Barr virus a decade prior. Meanwhile, individuals who developed ulcerative colitis showed a completely different pattern involving the body's own proteins.
paragraphs.zh: 這些測試揭示了每種疾病不同的抗體模式。例如，後來罹患克隆氏症的人在十年前就有對抗EB病毒的常見抗體。同時，罹患潰瘍性結腸炎的個人則顯示出涉及身體自身蛋白質的完全不同模式。

paragraphs.en: Experts note that these findings need confirmation in other groups and currently serve as a research tool rather than a clinic test. Yet, specialists hope that IBD might eventually be managed like type 1 diabetes, where early blood tests allow treatment to delay the onset of the disease.
paragraphs.zh: 專家指出，這些發現需要在其他群體中獲得確認，目前它作為一項研究工具而非臨床檢測。然而，專家們希望發炎性腸道疾病最終能夠像第一型糖尿病一樣受到控制，早期的血液檢測能夠讓治療延緩疾病的發作。

grammar.point: 關係代名詞 (Relative Pronoun)
grammar.explain: 用關代 which 引導子句修飾前面的先行詞 IBD，補充說明其造成的症狀。
grammar.example: At least 3.8 million people around the world live with IBD, which causes chronic digestive inflammation, pain, diarrhoea, and fatigue.
grammar.focus: which causes chronic digestive inflammation, pain, diarrhoea, and fatigue

grammar.point: 被動語態 (Passive Voice)
grammar.explain: 使用「be 動詞 + 過去分詞 (tested)」表達血液樣本是被研究人員所測試的。
grammar.example: Researchers at Mount Sinai and the Medical University of Vienna tested blood samples from US military personnel.
grammar.focus: tested blood samples

grammar.point: 不定詞作目的副詞用 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 使用「to + 原形動詞 (catch)」來表達醫生採取行動的目的。
grammar.example: This discovery brings new hope for doctors to catch the chronic condition much earlier than before.
grammar.focus: to catch the chronic condition much earlier than before

lessons.title: The University of Nevada now offers students the opportunity to minor in mariachi
lessons.title_zh: 內華達大學現為學生提供副修墨西哥街頭樂隊音樂的機會

paragraphs.en: Mariachi music has gained huge popularity among young people across the United States. Thousands of high school students who used to join typical choirs, bands, or orchestras now choose to take mariachi classes instead. This traditional Mexican style of music is spreading quickly in border areas like Texas and other regions with large Latino populations. Because interest is growing so fast, the demand for instructors has outpaced the available supply.
paragraphs.zh: 墨西哥街頭樂隊音樂（mariachi）全美年輕人之間獲得了極大的人氣。數以千計過去可能參加典型合唱團、樂團或管弦樂團的高中生，如今轉而選擇上墨西哥街頭樂隊課程。這種傳統的墨西哥音樂風格在德州等邊境地區以及其他擁有大量拉丁裔人口的區域迅速傳播。由於興趣增長極為迅速，對教師的需求已經超過了現有的供應。

paragraphs.en: To help solve this shortage, the University of Nevada, Las Vegas (UNLV), has introduced a brand-new minor program in teaching mariachi. Stephen Blanco, the director of mariachi at UNLV, is leading the effort to train future educators. Blanco grew up in Detroit, where the music was rarely played, but he later discovered the incredible enthusiasm for the genre during a performance trip with his high school ensemble in California.
paragraphs.zh: 為了協助解決這項短缺，內華達大學拉斯維加斯分校（UNLV）推出了一個全新的教學副修課程。該校的墨西哥街頭樂隊總監史蒂芬·布蘭科（Stephen Blanco）正帶領這項工作，培訓未來的教育工作者。布蘭科在底特律長大，那裡很少播放這種音樂，但他後來在帶著高中樂團前往加州演出的旅途中，發現了人們對該音樂類型的驚人熱情。

paragraphs.en: Violinist Axel Rodriguez Olivas became the very first student to declare this new minor at UNLV. He started learning mariachi under Blanco during high school and immediately developed a deep passion for it. For Rodriguez Olivas, studying this art form is not just about earning college credits. It also serves as a meaningful bridge that connects him to his Mexican American family, inspiring deeper conversations at home about their cultural roots.
paragraphs.zh: 小提琴手阿克塞爾·羅德里奎茲·奧利瓦斯（Axel Rodriguez Olivas）成為該校第一位申報這項新副修的學生。他在高中時期就跟隨布蘭科學習墨西哥街頭樂隊音樂，並立刻對其產生了深厚的熱情。對羅德里奎茲·奧利瓦斯而言，研讀這種藝術形式不僅僅是為了取得大學學分。它還充當了一座有意義的橋樑，將他與他的墨西哥裔美國家庭連結在一起，激發了家中關於其文化根源的更深層對話。

paragraphs.en: According to Blanco, mariachi has evolved beyond background entertainment at festivals. Today, audiences in Las Vegas gather in beautiful theaters to watch full concerts where mariachi acts take center stage. Furthermore, the new university minor helps satisfy the need for teachers in Clark County public schools, which are opening new programs each year.
paragraphs.zh: 根據布蘭科的說法，墨西哥街頭樂隊音樂已經演變為不僅僅是節慶中的背景娛樂。如今，拉斯維加斯的觀眾聚集在美麗的劇院裡觀看完整的音樂會，墨西哥街頭樂隊表演在其中成為舞台焦點。此外，這項新的大學副修課程有助於滿足克拉克郡公立學校對教師的需求，這些學校每年都在開設新的課程。

paragraphs.en: With many job possibilities ahead, Rodriguez Olivas is considering staying in Nevada after graduation so that he can teach local youth. As Rodriguez Olivas explained, he wants to "pave that path for them" so future generations can enjoy the musical culture.
paragraphs.zh: 面對未來的許多工作機會，羅德里奎茲·奧利瓦斯正在考慮畢業後留在內華達州，以便教導當地的年輕人。正如羅德里奎茲·奧利瓦斯所解釋的，他希望「為他們鋪平這條道路」，讓未來的世代能夠享受這種音樂文化。

grammar.point: 關係代名詞 (Relative Pronouns)
grammar.explain: 先行詞「Thousands of high school students」由關係代名詞「who」引導關係子句，在子句中作主詞使用。
grammar.example: Thousands of high school students who used to join typical choirs, bands, or orchestras now choose to take mariachi classes instead.
grammar.focus: who used to join typical choirs, bands, or orchestras

grammar.point: 不定詞表目的 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 不定詞片語「To help solve this shortage」放在句首，用來表達後面主要子句動作的目的，意思為「為了協助解決這個短缺」。
grammar.example: To help solve this shortage, the University of Nevada, Las Vegas (UNLV), has introduced a brand-new minor program in teaching mariachi.
grammar.focus: To help solve this shortage

grammar.point: 現在完成式 (Present Perfect Tense)
grammar.explain: 由「has」加上過去分詞「evolved」構成現在完成式，表示從過去持續到現在的演變狀態。
grammar.example: According to Blanco, mariachi has evolved beyond background entertainment at festivals.
grammar.focus: has evolved

lessons.title: £800,000 spent on scrapped sports dome project
lessons.title_zh: 已取消的體育巨蛋計畫耗資80萬英鎊

paragraphs.en: Ulster University (UU) in Northern Ireland has revealed that it spent £800,000 on an indoor sports arena before canceling the plan. First unveiled in 2024, the multimillion-pound facility in Londonderry was intended to host various activities, including rugby, football, and Gaelic games. However, the university scrapped the project in August because officials realized it was no longer financially possible to continue.
paragraphs.zh: 北愛爾蘭的阿爾斯特大學（Ulster University，簡稱 UU）透露，該校在取消計畫前，已在一座室內體育場館上花費了80萬英鎊。這座位於倫敦德里（Londonderry）、耗資數百萬英鎊的設施於2024年首次亮相，原先預計容納包含橄欖球、足球和蓋爾式運動在內的多種活動。然而，該大學在8月份取消了該計畫，因為相關主管意識到在財務上已無法繼續推行。

paragraphs.en: Details about the spending emerged after a Freedom of Information request from BBC Radio Foyle. The university explained that roughly £700,000 went toward project-related activities, while another £100,000 was used for governance and management. This disclosure came at a difficult time for UU, which previously announced it had to save around £25m and lay off up to 450 workers.
paragraphs.zh: 在英國廣播公司福伊爾廣播電台（BBC Radio Foyle）提出《資訊自由法》申請後，這筆支出的相關細節隨之曝光。該大學說明，大約有70萬英鎊用於與計畫相關的活動，另外10萬英鎊則用於治理與管理。這項揭露正值 UU 的艱困時期，該校先前已宣布必須節省約2500萬英鎊，並裁員多達450名員工。

paragraphs.en: Estimated building expenses had surged from an original £16.8m to £20.1m by the time leaders abandoned the idea. In addition, operating the 15,000-square-metre venue would have required more than £1m each year. The complex was supposed to receive £9.16m (€10.86m) from PeacePlus, an international programme supported by the European Union, the UK, the Irish government, and Stormont, alongside £8.3m from UU.
paragraphs.zh: 在負責人放棄該構想時，預估的建築費用已從最初的1680萬英鎊飆升至2010萬英鎊。此外，若要營運這座占地1萬5000平方公尺的場館，每年需要花費超過100萬英鎊。該綜合場館原定從由歐盟、英國政府、愛爾蘭政府和斯托蒙特（Stormont）共同支持的國際「PeacePlus」計畫獲得916萬英鎊（1086萬歐元），並由 UU 提供830萬英鎊。

paragraphs.en: Criticism followed the revelation. Sinéad McLaughlin, an SDLP assembly member, questioned why so much public money was spent before reaching such a conclusion. She noted that Northern Ireland's higher education system faced a funding crisis, meaning the university could never maintain the facility. Meanwhile, the university stated that ending the plan was "an inevitable consequence" of the wider financial difficulties in the sector.
paragraphs.zh: 此消息曝光後引發了批評。社會民主工黨（SDLP）議會成員西妮德．麥克勞克林（Sinéad McLaughlin）質疑，為何在得出這樣的結論之前，就耗費了如此多的公帑。她指出北愛爾蘭的高等教育體系正面臨財務危機，意味著該大學絕不可能維持該場館的維護運作。與此同時，該大學表示，停止這項計畫是該領域更廣泛財務困境下的「必然結果」。

paragraphs.en: The Special EU Programmes Body (SEUPB) confirmed that no PeacePlus money had been distributed for the building. Officials stated that they are now looking for ways to redirect the remaining funds to other helpful community developments. However, the agency could not promise that the reallocated money would stay in the north-west region.
paragraphs.zh: 特殊歐盟計畫機構（SEUPB）證實，尚未針對該建築發放任何 PeacePlus 資金。官員表示，他們目前正在尋找將剩餘資金重新分配至其他有益社區發展專案的方案。然而，該機構無法承諾重新分配的資金會留在西北部地區。

grammar.point: 過去完成式 (Past Perfect Tense)
grammar.explain: 以「had + 過去分詞」表示在過去另一個動作（放棄計畫）發生前就已經完成的事件或趨勢。
grammar.example: Estimated building expenses had surged from an original £16.8m to £20.1m by the time leaders abandoned the idea.
grammar.focus: had surged

grammar.point: 名詞子句作受詞 (Noun Clause as Object)
grammar.explain: 由疑問詞「why」引導名詞子句，在主要子句動詞「questioned」後面充當受詞。
grammar.example: Sinéad McLaughlin, an SDLP assembly member, questioned why so much public money was spent before reaching such a conclusion.
grammar.focus: why so much public money was spent before reaching such a conclusion

grammar.point: 分詞構句 (Participle Construction)
grammar.explain: 在逗號之後使用現在分詞「meaning」引導分詞片語，修飾前面的整個子句，用來補充說明帶來的結果。
grammar.example: She noted that Northern Ireland's higher education system faced a funding crisis, meaning the university could never maintain the facility.
grammar.focus: , meaning the university could never maintain the facility
